chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
The servant remains within the state of one performing tawaf around the Ka'bah so long as the hair of shaving remains upon him.

key_terms.الطَّائِفِ: the one performing tawaf around the Ka'bah
key_terms.الْحَلْقِ: the shaving, referring to the ritual shaving of the head
key_terms.الْعَبْدُ: the servant, meaning the human subject addressed by the ruling
key_terms.الْكَعْبَةِ: the Ka'bah, the Sacred House in Makkah
key_terms.حَدِّ: the limit, state, or legal standing

ai.seo_question: How long does a pilgrim remain in the ruling or sanctity of one performing tawaf around the Ka'bah after shaving?
ai.summary: This hadith states that a pilgrim continues to hold the status and sanctity associated with tawaf after shaving, as long as the hair from the shaving remains upon him. It indicates an ongoing ritual consideration connected to the rites of hajj.
